authored: Rendered in this repository by the game's local formant voice (src/audio/sam-voice.js). No third-party audio and no sam-js output.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Testing. Testing. This is... what is this.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: It's the street. Tell them it's the street.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: This... is the street.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Here we see the lamp post, in its natural habitat. Solitary. Nocturnal.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: He's lonely.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: He's not lonely. He's got a job to do.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: I light the pavement. Nobody thanks me.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Keep it down, keep it down, there's one coming.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: The night bus. Nobody knows where it goes. Nobody has ever come back.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: It's the forty-two. It goes to my mum's.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Nobody has ever come back from your mum's.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Give it here. Give it. It's my turn.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: And here we have the recordist. Rare. Very shy. Only comes out at night.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Don't.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: He's pretending he isn't listening. He's always listening.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: He thinks he's recording the street. He's recording me.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: ...Yeah.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: What are we going to do with this?

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Keep it. We'll play it when we're old.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: We'll do another one. We'll do loads.

lines.speaker: recordist
lines.text: Loads.
